newsitem.title: USA: Dow stocks push up to another record.
newsitem.headline: Dow stocks push up to another record.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks, with hardly a look back, Wednesday pushed upward from the 5,900 milestone passed a day earlier to set another record close as a firm bond market encouraged investors.

The Dow Jones industrial average added 29.07 points to end at 5,933.97, according to early, unofficial results. In the broader market, gainers led declines by nearly a 2-1 margin, with a moderate 441 million shares changing hands on the New York Stock Exchange. The Nasdaq index, which missed Tuesday's sharp climb, gained 14.61 points, or 1.20 percent, to 1,236.12.
